intended_use: Research and educational use for detecting seven annotated dental finding classes in panoramic radiographs.
clinical_status: Research prototype. Not validated or approved for autonomous diagnosis, clinical screening, treatment planning, or replacement of a dentist.
important_limitation: The model does not provide ICDAS staging or caries severity classification.
full_title: DentPanX-AI: A Software System for Multi-Class Dental Finding Detection in Panoramic Radiographs
